canonical_project: AWS Fayette County campus / Jefferson Township
aliases: AWS Fayette County campus / Jefferson Township

location.site_address: Bluegrass Boulevard / 1000 Innovation Way, Jeffersonville, OH 43128
location.parcel_notes: Amazon-linked Fayette County/Jefferson Township Site A Phase 1A is listed at Bluegrass Blvd; Project Galaxy force main and public trackers reference 1000 Innovation Way.

status_basis: As of 2026-08-11, AWS has announced the Fayette County site and official Ohio EPA records list active construction-stormwater, water-quality, road/utility, substation, and cooling-water-support authorizations. No official building occupancy, energization, or full construction completion evidence was found in this pass.

status_history.note: Promoted based on official AWS announcement, Fayette County zoning/CRA/easement records located through county minutes/search snippets, and current Ohio EPA construction and water authorization records.

actions.exact_result_status: County minutes/search-index text show an application requesting amendment of the 2007 Fayette County Zoning Resolution to allow data centers as a permitted use on industrial-zoned parcels.
actions.access_caveat: Official county scanned minutes; text confirmed through search snippet because the PDF is image-based.

actions.exact_result_status: County minutes/search-index text state commissioners approved the Fayette County Zoning Commissioner's recommendation to allow data centers as a permitted use on parcels in the relevant zoning category.
actions.access_caveat: Official county scanned minutes; text confirmed through search snippet because the PDF is image-based.

actions.exact_result_status: Amazon announced a $5 billion Fayette County first site within its $10 billion Ohio investment; no local vote was stated.
actions.access_caveat: Company source; not a local approval.

actions.exact_result_status: Local reporting and search-index text state the commissioners approved execution of a Community Reinvestment Area agreement between Fayette County and Amazon Data Services, Inc.
actions.access_caveat: Regional media summary of commissioner action; official scanned minutes were not machine-readable in this pass.

actions.exact_result_status: Ohio EPA construction permit 4GC10374*BG issued for Amazon Data Services, Fayette County/Jefferson Township Site B, with 196.16 acres of land disturbance.
actions.access_caveat: Official statewide permit list; it is land-disturbance authorization, not a building permit or local zoning vote.

actions.exact_result_status: County minutes/search-index text show a resolution authorizing an easement in Jefferson Township, Fayette County, for Amazon Data Services, Inc.
actions.access_caveat: Official county scanned minutes; text confirmed through search snippet because the PDF is image-based.

actions.exact_result_status: Ohio EPA construction permit 4GC10679*AG issued for Amazon Data Services S.R. 435/S.R. 739 improvements in Jeffersonville, 1.041 acres.
actions.access_caveat: Roadwork permit; separate from building construction.

actions.exact_result_status: Ohio EPA list records AES Ohio Fayette Sub Expansion, 37.2 acres, at Fent Road, supporting the site's power infrastructure; this is a utility/land-disturbance action, not a data-center building permit.
actions.access_caveat: Utility-support permit; no PUCO interconnection approval was located in this pass.

actions.exact_result_status: Ohio EPA list records AES Ohio Fayette Substation, 7.1 acres, at Fent Road, Jefferson Township.
actions.access_caveat: Substation land-disturbance permit; not an interconnection approval or building permit.

actions.exact_result_status: Ohio EPA issued permit 4GC10816*AG for Project Galaxy Force Main for Cooling Water Discharge, Amazon Data Services, at 1000 Innovation Way, 11.3 acres.
actions.access_caveat: Cooling-water force-main land-disturbance permit; it is not a building permit.

actions.exact_result_status: Ohio EPA granted Section 401 Water Quality Certification for CMH205 Data Center, Amazon Data Services, Fayette County/Jeffersonville, subject to conditions; the authorization is limited to water pollution and does not replace other permits.
actions.access_caveat: Official Ohio EPA certification; it is an environmental authorization, not local zoning/building approval.

actions.exact_result_status: Ohio EPA list records Amazon Fayette County/Jefferson Township Site A Phase 1A, 330 acres of land disturbance.
actions.access_caveat: Official permit list; no building occupancy or energization follows from this permit alone.

capacity_notes: No official MW/IT-load figure was confirmed. Third-party trackers conflict: Interconnection.fyi lists CMH220 as proposed 250+ MW, while datacenter.fyi lists CMH220 at 1,155 MW; Cleanview search results list individual 76 MW planned buildings. Capacity remains null pending official utility/interconnection evidence.

sources.match_reason: Exact Phase3↔regional stable-ID pair; seed merged only with explicit evidence

contradictions.description: Public trackers disagree and no official utility/interconnection capacity figure was confirmed.

sources.claim: Individual AWS Jeffersonville buildings shown as planned at 76 MW in search result snippets.

contradictions.description: AWS company announcement says an estimated $5 billion for the first Fayette County site within a $10 billion Ohio plan; Ohio Development's 2025 major-project map search result lists Amazon Data Services at Bluegrass Boulevard/Jeffersonville with $10 billion and 1,058 jobs. Treated as unresolved scope/aggregation difference.

sources.claim: Fayette County first site estimated at $5 billion; up to eight Ohio sites under $10 billion plan.
Ohio Development major-project map search result lists Amazon Data Services, Inc., Bluegrass Boulevard, Jeffersonville, $10 billion and 1,058 jobs.
